mechanism: feasibility oracle for the zone-repair base ablation (spec 2026-09-23 §8). Uses ONLY names advertised in world_interface.ablate_all.json: read the live zone from active_restriction_zones(), measure with zone_blockage, and rigidly shift the whole build away from the zone centre (direction = mean staging-circle centre minus zone centre) by hand -- set_desired_global_transform! on every AssemblyComplete start_config to its pre-edit global transform plus the shift, repeated until every node sits at its target (a parent set after its child moves the child again), plus the staging-circle records, then resync_scene_to_schedule! (D1, G3 2026-09-23: without it the free scene bodies stay behind and the run stalls) -- in steps of the zone radius until zone_blockage reports n_blocked == 0, then three more steps as navigation margin (one step left 2 goals inside the TangentBug inflation band). No restage/translate primitive, no solver. NEVER shown to any agent.
impl_code:
function OracleZoneClearNoBase!(env)
    zs = collect(active_restriction_zones())
    isempty(zs) && return (; status = :no_zone)
    zk = [first(p) for p in zs]
    blk = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zk, check_paths = true)
    blk.n_blocked == 0 && return (; status = :already_clear, moved = 0.0)
    z = last(first(zs))
    zc = Vector{Float64}(z.center[1:2]); zr = Float64(z.radius)
    cs = [Vector{Float64}(b.center[1:2]) for b in values(env.staging_circles)]
    bc = sum(cs) ./ length(cs)
    d = bc .- zc; nd = sqrt(sum(abs2, d))
    u = nd < 1e-9 ? [1.0, 0.0] : d ./ nd
    tnodes = Any[start_config(sn.node) for sn in env.sched.nodes if sn.node isa AssemblyComplete]
    function shift!(delta)
        dv = [delta[1], delta[2], 0.0]
        targets = [(t, (g0 = global_transform(t); typeof(g0)(g0.linear, g0.translation .+ dv))) for t in tnodes]
        for _ in 1:16
            moved_any = false
            for (t, g) in targets
                if maximum(abs.(global_transform(t).translation .- g.translation)) > 1e-9
                    set_desired_global_transform!(t, g)
                    moved_any = true
                end
            end
            moved_any || break
        end
        for aid in collect(keys(env.staging_circles))
            b = env.staging_circles[aid]
            env.staging_circles[aid] = Ball2(Vector{Float64}(b.center[1:2]) .+ delta[1:2], Float64(b.radius))
        end
        resync_scene_to_schedule!(env)
        return nothing
    end
    total = 0.0
    for k in 1:12
        shift!(u .* zr)
        total += zr
        reset_cache_resume!(env.cache, env.sched)
        blk = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zk, check_paths = true)
        if blk.n_blocked == 0
            shift!(u .* (3 * zr))
            total += 3 * zr
            reset_cache_resume!(env.cache, env.sched)
            return (; status = :translated, moved = total, steps = k + 3)
        end
    end
    return (; status = :residual_blocked, moved = total, residual = blk.n_blocked)
end
